question_en: Trace sections from a resolution through its CR's affected clauses (decision-to-section trace).
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.clausesAffected, sp.specNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
  AND cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected IS NOT NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec)
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
WITH DISTINCT r, cr, rk, cr.sourceAuthoredClausesAffected AS declaredField
UNWIND split(replace(replace(declaredField, ';', ','), '\n', ','), ',') AS declaredItem
WITH r, cr, rk, trim(replace(declaredItem, '\t', ' ')) AS item
WITH r, cr, rk, split(split(item, ' ')[0], '(')[0] AS atom
WITH r, cr, rk, CASE WHEN atom ENDS WITH '.' THEN substring(atom, 0, size(atom)-1) ELSE atom END AS clauseNumber
WHERE clauseNumber =~ '[0-9][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*|[A-Z](?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*'
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk)
WHERE s.sectionNumber = clauseNumber
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, s.sectionId AS sectionId
ORDER BY resolutionId, tdocNumber, sectionId
